Name: Better Tent
Author: peterbot0
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Better Tent[/b][/size]

[b]Make the vanilla Tent Kit useful earlier and keep it after every adventure.[/b][/center]

[line]

[size=4][b]Overview[/b][/size]

Better Tent makes the vanilla Tent Kit recipe available at Foraging Level 3. It also drops one replacement Tent Kit wherever a tent is destroyed, including after sleeping in it overnight.

The replacement is a normal ground item rather than being sent directly to your inventory. If your inventory is full, the kit simply remains on the ground until you have room to collect it.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Unlocks the vanilla Tent Kit recipe at Foraging Level 3.[/*]
[*]Changes the recipe to 50 Wood, 25 Fiber, and 1 Cloth.[/*]
[*]Produces the normal vanilla Tent Kit.[/*]
[*]Drops exactly one replacement Tent Kit when a tent is destroyed.[/*]
[*]Supports tents removed with tools, trampled by NPCs, left unused overnight, or used for sleeping.[/*]
[*]Leaves the replacement on the ground when the player's inventory is full.[/*]
[*]Preserves Stardew Valley's normal placement, sleeping, saving, energy recovery, and wake-up behavior.[/*]
[*]Works in multiplayer with shared replacement drops.[/*]
[*]Requires no configuration.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]How to Use[/b][/size]

Reach Foraging Level 3 to learn the Tent Kit recipe. Characters already at Foraging Level 3 or higher learn it when their save loads.

Craft and place the Tent Kit normally. When the tent is destroyed, one replacement Tent Kit drops where it stood.

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download Better Tent.[/*]
[*]Unzip the included [b]TrailTent[/b] folder into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Updating[/b]

Close Stardew Valley, then replace the existing [b]TrailTent[/b] folder with the one from the new download. Do not place the new folder inside the old one.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/*]
[*]No other mod or content pack is required[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility and Multiplayer[/b][/size]

Better Tent uses the vanilla Tent Kit and preserves the game's normal placement restrictions. It does not allow tents inside buildings, mines, festivals, obstructed areas, or anywhere else Stardew Valley normally prevents them.

Expansion locations work when they follow the game's normal outdoor tent-placement rules.

In multiplayer, each player learns the recipe independently. Replacement Tent Kits are shared world drops created by the host, so any player can collect them.

[size=4][b]Uninstallation[/b][/size]

Remove the [b]TrailTent[/b] folder from your Mods directory. The vanilla crafting recipe is restored. Characters who learned the recipe early may retain it in their save before reaching the normal vanilla unlock level.

[size=4][b]Support[/b][/size]

When reporting a problem, describe what you did, what you expected, and what happened. Please also upload your SMAPI log through [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI's log parser[/url] and include the resulting link.
